products.descriptionLong:
A 1-13/16″ (46 mm) gate valve to API 6A, rated 15,000 psi working pressure (15K). We supply it new from WOM, and other API 6A manufacturers, to the PSL, PR, material class and temperature class you specify. The table lists the models and nameplate markings we have seen at this bore and rating, so you can quote a make and model directly.

Each row is what is marked on a valve we have photographed at this bore and pressure; a dash means the nameplate does not state it or is not legible. Your valve is built to the specification you put on the RFQ, not to these plates.

Rating, test and flanges

  • Working pressure: 15,000 psi. API 6A shell test: 22,500 psi.
  • Flanged ends: API 6BX flanges at this size and rating take a BX-151 ring gasket.
  • Bore: full bore — the bore matches the nominal size, so wireline tools and pigs pass through.

Reading the nameplate

  • Temperature class letters combine: P = −20 °F to +180 °F; U = 0 °F to +250 °F; X = 0 °F to +350 °F. P+U covers −20 °F to +250 °F.
